description: Change a parcel's delivery status or correct its tracking. Only provided fields change; sending the stored values without a note changes nothing. The order's fulfillment and delivery status follow its parcels. Marking a parcel returned_to_sender puts its units back in stock when the order took stock; moving it off returned_to_sender takes them out again. No money moves. Refused for a canceled order. To add a parcel, create_shipment; a canceled parcel is replaced with a new one there. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

labelUrl.description: Shipping label link; null clears it

note.description: Saved in the parcel's status history

status.description: The parcel's new delivery status. A canceled parcel cannot leave canceled; a parcel the carrier has cannot go back to pending, label_purchased or canceled - mark it returned_to_sender instead

trackingNumber.description: Carrier tracking number; null clears it

trackingUrl.description: Tracking page link; null clears it

name: update_shipment
title: Update shipment
